{"tools":[
{"name":"create_event","description":"Creates a single calendar event with a title, start and end time, and optional location and notes. Use for blocking time such as supplier visits, inventory counts or store events when no invitations need to be sent.","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"calendar_id":{"type":"string","description":"Calendar to add the event to; defaults to the user's primary calendar."},"title":{"type":"string"},"start":{"type":"string","format":"date-time"},"end":{"type":"string","format":"date-time"},"all_day":{"type":"boolean","default":false},"location":{"type":"string"},"description":{"type":"string"},"color":{"type":"string"}},"required":["title","start","end"]},"request":"Put a block on my calendar for Friday 2pm to 4pm called 'Quarterly stock count' at the back warehouse."},
{"name":"get_event","description":"Retrieves full details of one calendar event by its ID, including attendees, location, reminders and recurrence. Use when you need to inspect a specific known event.","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"event_id":{"type":"string"},"calendar_id":{"type":"string"}},"required":["event_id"]},"request":"Show me all the details for event evt_88213, who's invited and where is it?"},
{"name":"update_event","description":"Changes fields of an existing event such as title, time, location or description. Use to reschedule or edit an event without recreating it.","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"event_id":{"type":"string"},"calendar_id":{"type":"string"},"title":{"type":"string"},"start":{"type":"string","format":"date-time"},"end":{"type":"string","format":"date-time"},"location":{"type":"string"},"description":{"type":"string"},"notify_attendees":{"type":"boolean","default":true},"apply_to":{"type":"string","enum":["this_instance","all_instances","this_and_following"],"default":"this_instance"}},"required":["event_id"]},"request":"Move the visual merchandising walkthrough, event evt_5521, to Thursday at 10:30 instead."},
{"name":"delete_event","description":"Permanently removes an event from a calendar, optionally notifying attendees. Use when an event is cancelled and should no longer appear.","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"event_id":{"type":"string"},"calendar_id":{"type":"string"},"notify_attendees":{"type":"boolean","default":true},"apply_to":{"type":"string","enum":["this_instance","all_instances","this_and_following"],"default":"this_instance"}},"required":["event_id"]},"request":"Delete the vendor tasting event evt_9034 from the calendar, the vendor pulled out."},
{"name":"list_events","description":"Lists events in a date range for one or more calendars, ordered by start time. Use to see what is scheduled on a given day or week.","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"calendar_ids":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"string"}},"start_date":{"type":"string","format":"date"},"end_date":{"type":"string","format":"date"},"max_results":{"type":"integer","default":50,"maximum":250},"include_declined":{"type":"boolean","default":false}},"required":["start_date","end_date"]},"request":"What do I have on my calendar next week, Monday through Sunday?"},
{"name":"search_events","description":"Searches events by keyword across title, description, location and attendees. Use when you remember something about an event but not its date or ID.","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"query":{"type":"string"},"calendar_ids":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"string"}},"start_date":{"type":"string","format":"date"},"end_date":{"type":"string","format":"date"},"attendee_email":{"type":"string","format":"email"},"limit":{"type":"integer","default":20}},"required":["query"]},"request":"Find that meeting where we talked about the holiday window display with Priya, I can't remember the date."},
{"name":"create_recurring_event","description":"Creates an event that repeats on a schedule, such as weekly or monthly, with optional end date or occurrence count. Use for standing routines like weekly team huddles or monthly safety checks.","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"title":{"type":"string"},"start":{"type":"string","format":"date-time"},"end":{"type":"string","format":"date-time"},"frequency":{"type":"string","enum":["daily","weekly","monthly","yearly"]},"interval":{"type":"integer","default":1},"days_of_week":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"string","enum":["MO","TU","WE","TH","FR","SA","SU"]}},"until":{"type":"string","format":"date"},"count":{"type":"integer"},"calendar_id":{"type":"string"},"location":{"type":"string"}},"required":["title","start","end","frequency"]},"request":"Set up a weekly opening-staff huddle every Monday and Thursday at 8:45am for 15 minutes, running through the end of December."},
{"name":"find_free_slots","description":"Finds time windows when all listed people are free for a given duration within a date range. Use before scheduling to pick a time that works for everyone.","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"attendee_emails":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"string","format":"email"},"minItems":1},"duration_minutes":{"type":"integer","minimum":5},"range_start":{"type":"string","format":"date-time"},"range_end":{"type":"string","format":"date-time"},"working_hours_only":{"type":"boolean","default":true},"max_suggestions":{"type":"integer","default":5}},"required":["attendee_emails","duration_minutes","range_start","range_end"]},"request":"When are Dana, Luis and I all free for a 45-minute chat sometime in the next three days?"},
{"name":"schedule_meeting","description":"Creates a meeting, sends invitations to attendees, and optionally adds a video conference link and agenda. Use when other people must be invited, not for solo calendar blocks.","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"title":{"type":"string"},"start":{"type":"string","format":"date-time"},"end":{"type":"string","format":"date-time"},"attendee_emails":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"string","format":"email"},"minItems":1},"agenda":{"type":"string"},"add_video_link":{"type":"boolean","default":false},"room_id":{"type":"string"},"send_invites":{"type":"boolean","default":true}},"required":["title","start","end","attendee_emails"]},"request":"Invite Dana and Luis to a video call tomorrow at 3pm for 30 minutes to go over the new supplier pricing."},
{"name":"respond_to_invitation","description":"Accepts, declines or tentatively accepts a meeting invitation on behalf of the user, with an optional comment to the organizer.","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"event_id":{"type":"string"},"response":{"type":"string","enum":["accepted","declined","tentative"]},"comment":{"type":"string"},"apply_to":{"type":"string","enum":["this_instance","all_instances"],"default":"this_instance"}},"required":["event_id","response"]},"request":"Decline the regional managers call, evt_7710, and tell them I'll be covering the register that afternoon."},
{"name":"add_event_attendees","description":"Adds additional people to an existing event and optionally sends them invitations. Use when someone was forgotten or needs to join late.","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"event_id":{"type":"string"},"attendee_emails":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"string","format":"email"},"minItems":1},"optional":{"type":"boolean","default":false},"send_invites":{"type":"boolean","default":true}},"required":["event_id","attendee_emails"]},"request":"Add Marcus from receiving to the Tuesday delivery planning meeting, evt_6402."},
{"name":"list_rooms","description":"Lists bookable rooms and resources such as meeting rooms, fitting rooms or training spaces, with capacity, location and equipment. Use to find which rooms exist or match requirements.","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"location":{"type":"string","description":"Store or building name."},"min_capacity":{"type":"integer"},"equipment":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"string","enum":["projector","whiteboard","video_conferencing","phone","accessible"]}}},"required":[]},"request":"Which rooms at the downtown store can seat at least 10 people and have a projector?"},
{"name":"check_room_availability","description":"Checks whether a specific room is free for a time window and returns conflicting bookings if any. Use before booking or to verify a room's schedule.","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"room_id":{"type":"string"},"start":{"type":"string","format":"date-time"},"end":{"type":"string","format":"date-time"}},"required":["room_id","start","end"]},"request":"Is the back training room free this Wednesday from 1pm to 3pm?"},
{"name":"book_room","description":"Reserves a room for a time slot, optionally linking it to an existing event. Use after confirming availability.","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"room_id":{"type":"string"},"start":{"type":"string","format":"date-time"},"end":{"type":"string","format":"date-time"},"purpose":{"type":"string"},"event_id":{"type":"string"},"expected_attendees":{"type":"integer"}},"required":["room_id","start","end"]},"request":"Reserve the second-floor conference room on Monday 9 to 11am for the seasonal hiring interviews."},
{"name":"cancel_room_booking","description":"Cancels an existing room reservation and frees the slot, without deleting any linked event. Use when the room is no longer needed.","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"booking_id":{"type":"string"},"reason":{"type":"string"}},"required":["booking_id"]},"request":"Release room booking bk_3318, we're doing the training on the shop floor instead."},
{"name":"create_reminder","description":"Creates a reminder that fires at a specific time or a set offset before an event, optionally recurring. Use for follow-ups and deadlines like renewing a permit.","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"text":{"type":"string"},"remind_at":{"type":"string","format":"date-time"},"event_id":{"type":"string","description":"If set, remind relative to this event."},"minutes_before":{"type":"integer"},"repeat":{"type":"string","enum":["none","daily","weekly","monthly"],"default":"none"},"channel":{"type":"string","enum":["push","email","sms"],"default":"push"}},"required":["text"]},"request":"Remind me next Tuesday at 9am to renew the store's fire safety permit."},
{"name":"list_reminders","description":"Lists upcoming or past reminders, filterable by status and date range. Use to review what reminders are pending.","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"status":{"type":"string","enum":["pending","fired","dismissed","all"],"default":"pending"},"from":{"type":"string","format":"date-time"},"to":{"type":"string","format":"date-time"},"limit":{"type":"integer","default":50}},"required":[]},"request":"What reminders do I still have pending for this week?"},
{"name":"dismiss_reminder","description":"Dismisses or snoozes a reminder that has fired or is pending. Use when the task is done or should be postponed.","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"reminder_id":{"type":"string"},"action":{"type":"string","enum":["dismiss","snooze"],"default":"dismiss"},"snooze_minutes":{"type":"integer","default":15}},"required":["reminder_id"]},"request":"Snooze reminder rem_4471 for an hour, I'm still dealing with the delivery driver."},
{"name":"book_customer_appointment","description":"Books a customer-facing appointment slot, such as a personal styling session, fitting or product consultation, on a staff member's calendar and sends the customer a confirmation. Use for scheduling time with a customer, not internal meetings.","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"customer_name":{"type":"string"},"customer_email":{"type":"string","format":"email"},"customer_phone":{"type":"string"},"service":{"type":"string","description":"Appointment type, e.g. 'bridal fitting'."},"staff_email":{"type":"string","format":"email"},"start":{"type":"string","format":"date-time"},"duration_minutes":{"type":"integer","default":30},"notes":{"type":"string"},"send_confirmation":{"type":"boolean","default":true}},"required":["customer_name","service","staff_email","start"]},"request":"Book Mrs. Alvarez for a 60-minute suit fitting with Tom this Saturday at 11am and email her a confirmation."},
{"name":"generate_calendar_report","description":"Produces a summary of calendar usage over a period, such as hours spent in meetings, busiest days, room utilization or appointment counts per staff member. Use for scheduling analysis, not sales or financial reports.","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"start_date":{"type":"string","format":"date"},"end_date":{"type":"string","format":"date"},"report_type":{"type":"string","enum":["meeting_hours","room_utilization","appointments_by_staff","busiest_times"]},"group_by":{"type":"string","enum":["day","week","month","person","room"],"default":"week"},"calendar_ids":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"string"}},"format":{"type":"string","enum":["summary","csv"],"default":"summary"}},"required":["start_date","end_date","report_type"]},"request":"Give me a report of how much each meeting room was used last month so I can decide if we need another one."}
]}
